Independent modular ranks 61,79 and exact Smith B3 rank79 with unit factors establish H2(Z)=Z5. Each orbit representative is primitive; all orbit-augmented Smith forms have rank84 with exactly one nonunit 2 for orbit10 and all units for each larger orbit. Exact quotient argument proves indices. The bundled verifier reconstructs and checks these matrix objects.

value.rationale: The first natural exact induced-support classification in the Petersen matching complex identifies which geometrically minimal sphere classes generate ambient H2 integrally. The exceptional 10-member orbit spans index two even though all its spheres are individually primitive, while 60- and 40-member orbits saturate. This integral symmetry-orbit obstruction cannot be recovered from known H2 rank or rational S5-character and is a motivated local-to-global structural invariant.
